_note: Dispatch routing for the CLI runners (/dw-claude-run, /dw-codex-run) via the dw-cli-run skill. Maps a task's Conventional-Commit type to a tier, and a tier to a concrete model + effort per brand. Seeded once on init and NEVER overwritten on update — model availability differs per account, so this file is yours to edit. Verify the model ids against `claude --help` / `codex --help` before trusting them; the shipped values are conservative defaults, not a guarantee that your account has access.

light._use: mechanical, low-ambiguity work; the answer is obvious and the diff is small

by_commit_type._note: The task's type is already declared in tasks.md and in the atomic commit subject — no new inference needed.

escalate_on_surface._note: If the task's fence touches any of these, override the type-derived tier upward. Match against file paths and the task title.

validation._note: The worker never signs off on its own exam. Cross-brand is the default because a second vendor fails differently.
validation.degrade: When only one brand is installed, validate in a SEPARATE dispatch at a different tier — never reuse the executing session.

defaults._note: Applied to every dispatch unless the prompt names a capability that needs otherwise.
